newsitem.title: AFGHANISTAN: U.N. peace envoy in Kabul to meet victors.
newsitem.headline: U.N. peace envoy in Kabul to meet victors.

text.p: United Nations special envoy Norbert Holl flew into Kabul on Sunday for his first meeting with Afghanistan's new Taleban movement administration.
He was expected to convey a U.N. protest against the killing on Friday of former president Najibullah and his brother Shahpur Ahmadzai after the Islamic Taleban militia captured Kabul.
Holl declined to speak to reporters at Kabul airport, where he was met by a Taleban council member, Baz Mohammad, and protocol chief Mullah Hafeezullah.
The United Nations Security Council late on Saturday deplored the "brutal execution" of Najibullah, who was abducted by Taleban fighters from a U.N. compound where he had been given asylum.
